title: Habitat radiomics analysis for progression free survival in non-small cell lung cancer
abstract: BACKGROUND: Non-small cell lung cancer is heterogeneous. METHODS: We retrospectively enrolled 240 patients and performed external validation. RESULTS: AUC 0.82. LIMITATIONS: single centre.
